mapper.select: SELECT ID id, THEME theme, BEGIN_TIME beginTime, END_TIME endTime, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(EXT_JSON,'$.userName')) as userName, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(EXT_JSON,'$.roomName')) as roomName FROM CONFERENCE_REZ WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' AND END_TIME > NOW() AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(EXT_JSON,'$.roomId')) = #{param.roomId} ORDER BY BEGIN_TIME ASC LIMIT #{param.limit}
